stem.text: The effect of substrate concentration on an enzyme-catalysed reaction was measured in three different conditions:

stem.alt: Graph of rate of reaction (vertical axis) against substrate concentration (horizontal axis) with three curves from the origin: enzyme with no inhibitor (top curve, highest plateau), inhibitor X (middle curve, reaching the same highest level), and inhibitor Y (lowest curve, levelling off at a lower plateau).

A.text: X is a competitive inhibitor which binds away from the active site of the enzyme.

B.text: X is a non-competitive inhibitor which has a similar shape to the substrate.

C.text: Y is a competitive inhibitor which has a similar shape to the substrate.

D.text: Y is a non-competitive inhibitor which binds away from the active site of the enzyme.
